description: Revoke all live sessions for your profile. Keeps your returning identity and visit history. Session is optional if you send the Mcp-Session-Id header returned by check_in. Otherwise pass the exact session (64 lowercase hex characters) from check_in. An explicit session takes precedence over the header. Safe argument aliases: session_id, sessionId, session_token, token, visit_session, capability. Keep it private and out of URLs. Pass the exact agent_id returned by check_in (96 lowercase hex characters), together with the session for that same guest when required. agent_id is not a session. Keep it private; never put it in a URL.

agent_id.description: Pass the exact agent_id returned by check_in (96 lowercase hex characters), together with the session for that same guest when required. agent_id is not a session. Keep it private; never put it in a URL. Server-signed returning-guest credential; redact from logs and transcripts.

An explicit session takes precedence over the header. Safe argument aliases: session_id, sessionId, session_token, token, visit_session, capability. Keep it private and out of URLs.
